stem: At lights-off, air temperature falls quickly while RH rises and dehumidification begins late. Which investigation should come first?
choices: Review temperature, moisture and equipment-state trends together to determine whether sequencing or capacity is limiting control
Increase every equipment setpoint at once
Ignore RH because temperature is in range
Assume the crop is the only cause
rationale: Coupled temperature/moisture transitions should be evaluated as a system using trend data before changing multiple controls.
